protocol.scope: All 96 saved quarters 2002-2025, all available industries, no sampling
protocol.target: Active permit closure report within next365 days
protocol.model: separate LR C1 max_iter2000 seed7 per industry
protocol.eligibility: training AND calibration each n>=200 events>=20 non-events>=20; no evaluation-label selection
protocol.calibration_method: industry-specific intercept by calibration logloss then region shift with shrink500
protocol.comparison: separate raw vs pooled raw isolates training; separate calibrated vs pooled candidate compares complete pipelines
protocol.aggregate: Same eligible industries per quarter; n-weighted Brier and logloss; excluded industries recorded
protocol.warning: Post-hoc experiment on reused evaluation data, not independent confirmation; no parameter search
